name: K-T2
description: The performance comparison of TVC and the own cloud pass (owner order 2026-11-12). Five views (ground at 200 m, inside the deck, above, orbit edge, sky from 200 m) at one universal time chosen by the field (the first hour from a fixed base with cover >= 0.5 at 3 km and the sun 15 to 60 degrees up, the same in every start), the same camera for every variant, at 1707x960 and 2560x1440, Medium, A4500, vertical sync off. Own starts (EVE removed, so nothing else draws clouds): off (no clouds from us: the baseline frame), plain, recon4 (reconstruction in 4x4 blocks), entry (plain plus the entry refinement), then at the inside view only edge (edge-adaptive mode), heightoff (the T13 switches off: their cost = plain minus heightoff), cap2 (layer cap 2), and gain (cloud.sunGain and cloud.moonGain reach the pass). TVC start (EVE and Scatterer present): tvc (cloudSource Eve, EVE draws the maps of our field). The cost of the clouds in a view is the GPU frame of the variant minus the GPU frame of off at the same view and resolution (label independent; TVC against the off of the own start of the same resolution, the universal times are compared by T09.ut_spread_s), cross-checked for the own pass by the GPU profiler's group 'ReDefinition clouds' (the begin and end markers the pass puts around itself; T09.perf.markers_agree). TVC draws its own layer set (the pack's layers plus the painter's layer at 2700 m), the own pass its four layers: the columns compare two systems at the same camera, not equal clouds, and the views 'inside' (4550 m) and 'above' (8300 m) are relative to our layers, not to TVC's. tools/weather_metrics/kt2.py computes the milliseconds from the logs of all starts (the 'metrics' entry); the first TVC report's costliest labels and the labels its pattern matched are in the run's notes. A timing series, so the GPU lock is exclusive. Expected results are written in tests/series/rows/T09.json before the run. Run order: own1707 first (it validates the markers, the placement and the clock), then tvc1707.

starts.description: the own pass at 1707x960 with EVE removed: off, plain, recon4, entry in the five views (30 s each), then edge, heightoff, cap2 at the inside view (25 s each) and the gain check; about 15 minutes of game time
TVC alone at 1707x960: the five views, 30 s each; needs EVE with the raymarched layers and Scatterer (the probe fails the start at once without them)
